outcomes.text: UNSIGNED local candidate. Verified work is paid by the account GasSchedule at min(basefee + configured priority, class ceiling), routine markup on routine gas, plus workFee per service unit. One calculation supplies quote, compensation and relevant charges. Receipt gas is measured separately. The existing 1.75M per-position batch quote comparison remains visible; it does not prove keeper profitability or economic acceptance.

UNSIGNED local candidate. A successful checkpoint prices holder flows once. Redemptions fill pro rata using free cash and actually committing gross deposits. Caller-funded bounded work and funded checkpoints support complete exits. Every liability, including contribution refunds, stays excluded from free cash.

UNSIGNED local candidate. After complete wind-down the residual belongs only to dead shares and independently attributed rounding reserves; no holder, contribution refund or claim is treated as investable residual. The historical 0.012 ETH comparison is preserved for measurement, not reused approval.

UNSIGNED local candidate. Gross pending deposits, redemption/distribution reserves, claimables, processing contributions and finalized contribution refunds are protected liabilities. Pricing work debits its explicit source; contribution cash is never temporarily general free ETH.

UNSIGNED local candidate. Numerical gas calibration is immediately adjustable. Ordinary sync uses routine permissions; requested pricing scans/tails may use explicit sponsorship; checkpoint debits that era even when it completes the final redemption. Unpaid recovery is caller funded under a stated wallet cap. Raising an allowance creates no cash.

UNSIGNED, unified candidate. FWA token rewards (D43): claimed and burned, never sold. Supply falls by exactly the claimed amount and the burn pays the caller no ETH, so holders pay no gas and get no token value.

UNSIGNED, unified candidate. Oracle failure cannot trap assets (D34): with FWA's floor oracle repointed so no quote can be read, nothing new lists unless FWA exempts the collection from its oracle (then no cap applies, D62), yet the kicked pack is back in inventory and a holder redeeming everything is paid (measured 0.9975 ETH of a 1 ETH deposit).

UNSIGNED local candidate. Zero-acquisition loss includes three actual 0.001 ETH paid primary mint fees per fresh 0.03 ETH pack, actual keeper compensation once, construction/checkpoint/exit charges and wallet gas. Existing 250 bps comparison is retained as a measurement target, not a claim that the new candidate meets it.

UNSIGNED, unified candidate. A listing made while FWA's queue is busy would be staged and earn nothing. The vault refuses to list while the queue is busy (D62, audit B), so nothing it lists is staged; once the queue drains the relist goes in active.

UNSIGNED local candidate. A keep transfers the actual 0.03 ETH pack to the purchaser and returns backing less the live settlement fee to the account: 0.2079 ETH at 1% on the local 0.21 ETH backing. Three replacement mints pay the actual live primary fee. Zero-fee maximum B-P is stored incrementally as unresolved keep uplift; local checkpoint bound25bps is provisional.
